verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Ollama serves an llms.txt at ollama.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and docs.ollama.com also publishes an llms.txt indexing agent-consumable resources such as the OpenAPI spec, with docs pages available as .md files. Missing for 10: no hands-on or independent corroboration of agents consuming these docs, the ollama.com/docs.md markdown variant returns 404, and there is no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content dump.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The docs llms.txt lists it under "## OpenAPI Specs" as "[openapi](/openapi.yaml)".
